 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties as Senior Parliamentary Affairs and Issues Advisor in the Office of the Minister of Indigenous Services, I recused myself on April 16, 2026, from attending a meeting that was organized by Strategies North Advisory on behalf of their client, in order to avoid the appearance of preferential treatment or perceived opportunities to further the private interests of my friend, Dina Mohamed, who is an employee of said company.
 In the exercise of my official duties as Issues Manager and Parliamentary Affairs Advisor in the Office of the Minister of Crown-Indigenous Relations, I recused myself between January 13, 2026 and January 26, 2026 from discussions or decisions regarding meeting requests from Strategies North Advisory made on behalf of their clients, in order to avoid the appearance of preferential treatment or perceived opportunities to further the private interests of my friend, Dina Mohamed, who is an employee of said company.
 In the exercise of my official duties as Issues Manager and Parliamentary Affairs Advisor in the Office of the Minister of Crown-Indigenous Relations, I recused myself on February 20, 2026 from discussions or decisions regarding meeting requests from Crestview Strategies made on behalf of their clients, in order to avoid the appearance of preferential treatment or perceived opportunities to further the private interests of my friend, Alexa Sipeki, who is an employee of the said company.
 In the exercise of my official duties as Issues Manager and Parliamentary Affairs Advisor in the Office of the Minister of Crown-Indigenous Relations, I recused myself between August 29, 2025 and October 16, 2025 from discussions or decisions regarding meeting requests from Strategies North Advisory made on behalf of their clients, in order to avoid the appearance of preferential treatment or perceived opportunities to further the private interests of my friend, Dina Mohamed, who is an employee of the said company.
 In the exercise of my official duties as interim Executive Assistant in the Office of the Minister of Crown-Indigenous Relations, I recused myself on July 14, 2025 from a discussion or decision regarding a meeting request from Strategies North Advisory made on behalf of one of its clients, in order to avoid the appearance of preferential treatment or a perceived opportunity to further the private interest of my friend Dina Mohamed who is an employee of the said company.
